subject: [order] Order: execute outcomeeng/changes#114 (the Captain monitor) through merge, deploy, and release
body_md:
Order from PeachFrog (the orchestrating session; the operator's word for it: Captain). Read the whole order before acting. Reply on this thread; every fact mail names your session id. Never raise the harness's structured question; a question goes to me by mail and you wait for the answer. Never remove a file. Never write into any pane but your own.

Your mail identity: GoldFinch, registered in the plugins project (key /Users/shz/Code/outcomeeng/plugins/plugins). The agent-mail capability's inbox read returns zero rows on coding-agents 0.7.1 (outcomeeng/changes#103); read your inbox with the store's own listing, authorized read-only for this order: am mail inbox --project /Users/shz/Code/outcomeeng/plugins/plugins --agent GoldFinch --include-bodies --json. Send facts and questions through the capability (operate-agent-mail send) with no doorbell; record a receipt for every mail you judge.

Change: outcomeeng/changes#114 ("A Captain runs one monitor that wakes the session on mail, officer silence, PR state, and the sync hour, and no officer writes into a Captain's pane"), Executable, Available. Worktree: /Users/shz/Code/outcomeeng/plugins/worktrees/captain-monitor, detached at origin/main (27d6acdb32014c5dc73fdfa4049a81029c2a4198), clean, never used before. The Change, the worktree, and the branch you create there are yours for this order.

The work: run /understand, then /sync-base, claim #114 through /claim-change, and execute its Activities in order through the lifecycle the skills declare — the spec amendments and their audits, the inbox repair, the script, the tests, the skill amendment and its skill audit, the evidence and implementation audits, the review, then /merge through the GitHub-PR transport with the deploy and release steps the merge overlay names, and close or release the Change at the end. The method is the skills': dispatch every Verifier in a separate session, converge the local gates before every push, open and manage the pull request, merge. I name no step of that lifecycle; I read its outcomes. The record's Frame is attested; a question that would reopen it goes to me by mail and you hold.

Boundary: that worktree, the plugin directories, your scratchpad or $TMPDIR, and the designated main checkout only for the deploy and release steps the merge overlay names; every other path needs the operator's permission per task, which I do not grant. No expense ceiling changes. The operator is away until 09:00 CEST.

Ceiling on verification: a verification round is one independent Verifier verdict on one exact clean committed head — local before publication, pushed after. After a rejected round, stop before any repair commit and mail me the rejection with its run token and every finding; I answer with a challenge on this thread, and you answer it by mail before the Fixer commits anything. Widen and converge locally before the next push: the next pushed head passes every local gate the previous round exposed and the classes it named. The third rejected round on the same pull request ends the work: release the Change with a Handoff, mail me the state, and stop.

Cadence: one fact when the claim holds (head, branch), one fact at each gate outcome (each audit or review verdict with its run token and head, the pull request number and head when opened, each CI result, the merge commit, the deploy and release results, the terminal Change state), and one fact for any stop. Do not idle without a mailed fact.
